snapshot.title: MCP resource subscriptions and update notifications
snapshot.description:
Expose items as MCP resources (e.g. `kiln://items/<id>`, returning the markdown view) and send `notifications/resources/updated` to sessions that subscribed when an item changes. Check the go-sdk's resource and subscription API first.

Optional by spec: the revision check stays the guarantee. Also update `internal/mcp/doc.go`, which already describes this.
